questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Koch arbeitete gerade an einer dringenden Sache.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Koch was just working on an urgent matter.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte aber trotzdem einen Augenblick Zeit mit seinem Kollegen Thomas zu sprechen.

answers.answer_text: However he had a moment's time nevertheless to talk to his colleague Thomas.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Thomas wollte wissen, an wen er sich wenden kann, wenn er ärztliche Hilfe braucht.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Thomas wanted to know who to go to when he needs help from a doctor.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er wohnt nicht weit von einem Krankenhaus, aber er kennt keine Ärzte in der Stadt.

answers.answer_text: He doesn't live far from a hospital, but he doesn't know any doctors in town.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Koch schlug ihm vor, das Gesundheitsamt in seinem Wohnort anzurufen.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Koch suggested (to him) calling the Board of Health where he lives.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dort könnte er sich nach den Adressen einiger Ärzte in seinem Bezirk erkundigen.

answers.answer_text: There he would be able to ask for the addresses of a few doctors in his section of town.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Thomas wollte das bald tun, denn bei seiner grossen Familie ist öfter mal einer krank.

answers.answer_text: Thomas was planning to do that soon, for with a family as large as his there's pretty often someone sick.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Koch würde ihm seinen Hausarzt empfehlen, wenn dessen Praxis nicht so weit entfernt wäre.

answers.answer_text: Koch would recommend his family doctor to him if his office weren't so far away.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Frau Thomas war voriges Jahr bei einem Ohrenarzt in Amerika in Behandlung.

answers.answer_text: Mrs. Thomas was under the care of an ear doctor in America last year.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sie hatte eine schwere Mittelohrenzündung, aber jetzt geht es ihr wieder gut.

answers.answer_text: She had a bad middle ear infection, but she's all right now.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Trotzdem möchte ihr Mann, dass sie sich in Deutschland nochmal von einem Facharzt untersuchen lässt.

answers.answer_text: Nevertheless her husband would like her to have herself examined again by a specialist in Germany.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Koch konnte ihm einen guten Hals- Nasen und Ohrenarzt empfehlen.

answers.answer_text: Koch was able to recommend a good ear, nose and throat man to him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Thomas erkundigte sich bei dem Arzt nach dessen Sprechstunde.

answers.answer_text: Thomas inquired at the doctor's about his office hours.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Das Telefon klingelte in der Praxis von Dr. Buchner.

answers.answer_text: The telephone rang at Dr. Buchner's office.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schwester Ursula meldete sich.

answers.answer_text: Sister Ursula answered.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Am Apparat war Frau Evans, die wegen ihres Sohnes anrief.

answers.answer_text: Mrs. Evans, who was calling about her son was on the wire.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte sich das Knie aufgeschlagen, und die Wunde war ziemlich gross.

answers.answer_text: He had fallen and scraped his knee, and the wound was pretty big.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Die Schwester schlug Frau Evans vor, gleich mit ihm in die Sprechstunde zu kommen.

answers.answer_text: The nurse suggested that Mrs. Evans come right to the office with him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dr. Buchner würde ihn sofort behandeln.

answers.answer_text: Dr. Buchner would treat him immediately.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Herr Lange war um drei Uhr zu Dr. Buchner bestellt.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Lange had an appointment with Dr. Buchner at three o'clock.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Schwester Ursula bat ihn, im Wartzimmer Platz zu nehmen und sich etwas zu gedulden, denn es war noch ein Patient im Sprechzimmer.

answers.answer_text: Sister Ursula asked him to take a seat in the waiting room and wait a bit, for there was still a patient in the consulting room.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Als Lange ins Wartzimmer kam, sah er Evans dort sitzen.

answers.answer_text: When Lange came into the waiting room he saw Evans sitting there.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Evans war nicht krank, sondern wartete auf seine Frau und seinen Sohn.

answers.answer_text: Evans was not sick, but was waiting for his wife and son.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sein Sohn hatte einen Unfall gehabt, er war mit dem Fahrrad gestürzt.

answers.answer_text: His son had had an accident; he had fallen with his bicycle.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er hatte sich das Knie verletzt.

answers.answer_text: He had injured his knee.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wäre es gut, wenn er eine Tetanusspritze bekommen würde?

answers.answer_text: Would it be [a] good [thing] if he were to get a tetanus shot?

questions_and_answers.question_text: 'Hoffentlich hat der Junge nicht zu grosse Schmerzen,' sagte Lange.

answers.answer_text: 'I hope the boy is not having too much pain,' said Lange.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lange war wegen seines Herzens dort.

answers.answer_text: Lange was there on account of his heart.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Statt eine Nachkur zu machen, hatte er schon wieder angefangen zu arbeiten.

answers.answer_text: Instead of taking a follow-up treatment he had started to work again already.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ihn strengte alles, was er tat, sehr an.

answers.answer_text: Everything he did was tiring him [out] very much.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Die Schwester bat Herrn Lange nun ins Sprechzimmer, und Evans wünschte ihm gute Besserung.

answers.answer_text: The nurse now asked Mr. Lange into the consulting room, and Evans wished him a speedy recovery.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nachdem Dr. Buchner Herrn Lange begrüsst hatte, fragte er nach seinen Beschwerden.

answers.answer_text: After Dr. Buchner had said hello to Lange he asked about his complaints.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lange hatte trotz der Kur immer noch Herzbeschwerden.

answers.answer_text: Lange was still having trouble with his heart in spite of the treatment at the resort.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er nahm die Medikamente, die der Arzt ihm verschrieben hatte, regelmässig ein.

answers.answer_text: He was taking the medicine regularly that the doctor had prescribed for him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nach der geringsten Anstrengung bekam er aber starkes Herzklopfen und wurde leicht schwindlig.

answers.answer_text: After the slightest exertion however he got severe palpitations and got dizzy easily.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nachdem Dr. Buchner den Blutdruck gemessen hatte, sagte er: 'Er ist noch etwas zu hoch.'

answers.answer_text: After Dr. Buchner had measured his blood pressure he said:' It is a bit too high still.'

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er schlug ihm vor, statt Kaffee Fruchtsaft zu trinken.

answers.answer_text: He suggested drinking fruit juice instead of coffee to him.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Es würde nichts schaden, wenn er seine Diät genau einhalten würde, sagte Dr. Buchner.

answers.answer_text: It wouldn't hurt a bit if he were to stick to his diet exactly, said Dr. Buchner.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Dann verschrieb ihm der Arzt noch eine andere Medizin.

answers.answer_text: Then the doctor prescribed another medicine for him in addition.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Er musste dreimal täglich je fünfzehn Tropfen davon einnehmen.

answers.answer_text: He had to take fifteen drops of it three times a day.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Ein Rezept für die Tabletten bekam er nicht.

answers.answer_text: He did not get a prescription for the pills.
